research.claim: Nigeria earned about $35 million from hibiscus (zobo leaf) exports in nine months of 2017, mostly shipped to Mexico in 1,983 containers.
NAFDAC says zobo sold loose needs no registration number, but once it is packaged, sealed and labelled it must be registered.
Unpreserved zobo spoils within 24 to 48 hours at room temperature and lasts only about 5 to 7 days refrigerated, so scaling needs cold chain or preservation.
Export hibiscus is sourced from smallholder co-operatives in northern Nigeria and Kano aggregators, then sold in bulk to buyers in the US and UK.
